meta.name: business-health-diagnostic
meta.description: Diagnose SaaS business health across growth, retention, efficiency, and capital. Use when preparing a business review or prioritizing urgent fixes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断SaaS业务健康度，聚焦增长、留存与效率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责SaaS产品运营，需要快速定位业务短板
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose SaaS business health across growth, retention, and efficiency
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a SaaS product and need to quickly identify weak spots

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你提供公司阶段和关键指标（如增长率、NRR、CAC、烧钱率等），然后从增长、留存、单位经济和资本效率四个维度评估 SaaS 业务健康度，并给出评分、红旗警告和优先行动建议。
howto.when: 当你准备董事会汇报、季度回顾或融资准备，需要全面诊断 SaaS 业务健康时触发。也可以直接输入指标（如“$8M ARR, 60% YoY growth”）启动。

say.text: 帮我做一次业务健康诊断，我准备董事会材料。
say.note: Claude 会引导你提供公司阶段和指标。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to provide company stage and key metrics (e.g., growth rate, NRR, CAC, burn rate), then assess SaaS business health across growth, retention, unit economics, and capital efficiency, delivering a scorecard, red flags, and prioritized recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a comprehensive SaaS health diagnostic for board meetings, quarterly reviews, or fundraising prep. You can also invoke it directly with metrics (e.g., "$8M ARR, 60% YoY growth").

say_en.text: Run a business health diagnostic, I'm preparing board materials.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for stage and metrics.

say_en.text: Diagnose: $8M ARR, 60% YoY growth, NRR 96%, CAC payback 21 months, 14 months runway.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a health score and action plan.
